summary:
TeleCall - Official MTProto Real Logout & Android WebView API Bridge Implementation Plan:
1. Real Telegram Server Logout: Implement MTProto Api.auth.LogOut() on the backend to immediately terminate and destroy the active Telegram session on official Telegram servers when logging out.
2. Capacitor & Android APK API URL Resolution: Fix the 'Unexpected token <' HTML error by dynamically resolving the backend API base URL for Capacitor native WebView (pointing to the live deployed server instead of local file assets).
3. TeleCall Branding & APK Configuration: Update app branding, headers, Android strings.xml to 'TeleCall', and fix default developer setup warning display.
4. Comprehensive Verification: Verify status endpoint, logout termination, and rebuild Android assets + source zip.
